study type: Experimental animal study (in vivo) and in vitro cell culture study
outcome: Maternal liver, heart, and kidney health
Expression levels of BMP2, BMPR2, Smad1, and Smad5
cohort: Pregnant mice and mouse embryonic stem cell D3 (ES) and mouse embryonic fibroblast 3T3 (3T3) cell lines.
finding: Ligusticum chuanxiong (CR) decoction demonstrated potential embryotoxicity, particularly at high doses (e.g., 32 g/kg/d in mice), by increasing absorbed fetuses and inhibiting key genes in the BMP-SMADs signaling pathway, while normal dosages appeared safe.
